sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Second Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1992
ACT IV OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th February, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/3031,
dated 16-2-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 2nd February, 1992 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 12th February, 1992, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 134 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979

ACT IV OF 1992
ACT IV OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th February, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/3031,
dated 16-2-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 2nd February, 1992 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 12th February, 1992, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
2. Amendment of section 134 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979.-In
the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P.
Ordinance IV of 1979), for section 134, the following shall be substituted
namely:
"134. Taxes to be levied.--Subject to any other
law for the time being in force and with the prior approval of Government, a
Local Council may, or where directed by Government shall, levy all or any of
the taxes enumerated in the Second Schedule."
